Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts. Responsibilities Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management. Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity). Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means. Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly. Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs. Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns. Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures. Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals. What we're looking for Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: About Lemon.io Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers. Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation. The Role You will own engineering at Lemon.io . You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder. What You’ll Do: Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake. Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost. Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is. Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill. Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code. Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy. Who You Are: Product-minded, business-first Obsessed with simplicity First principles thinker Fast. Bias toward action Experience: You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company. You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling. You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team. Why Lemon.io : Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals. A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open. Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship. A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers. A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! The role You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon. Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent. We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet. What you'll do Build the stack. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer. Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model. Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on. Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results. Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads. What we need from you You understand hardware performance. You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. jobs.title: Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) – Python & IoT Edge
jobs.description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) in our IoT team, you build the software foundation for all our Linux-based devices, on ARM and x86. At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base. The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Your code sits close to the hardware but runs on top of Linux. Kernel development and microcontroller firmware are not part of the job. If well-designed software for Linux devices is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Unified platform layer: Design and build a platform layer that covers all our device types, both ARM and x86. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction. Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily. Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application. Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction. Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health. Debugging: Analyze and solve complex issues at application and system level, such as memory leaks, network instability or service failures. Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards. Inspire us by Senior software engineering experience: 5+ years of professional software development, with a strong part of it on Linux-based devices or edge systems. Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus. Architecture know-how: You have designed and evolved software architectures, applied design patterns, and made trade-off decisions you can explain clearly. Ideally you have built a platform, framework or shared library that other teams or services build on. IoT background: Hands-on experience building software for connected devices, ideally operated as a fleet in the field. Linux user-space expertise: Solid knowledge of Linux, systemd, networking, IPC, Bash and Docker, ideally across different hardware architectures (ARM and x86). Debugging skills: Experience troubleshooting system-level issues with tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind or profilers. Engineering mindset: Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Language skills: Fluent English (C1). Strong plus Experience building, customizing and maintaining Linux images with Yocto . Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets, including OTA updates and device monitoring Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf) Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems or network devices Experience with edge AI, computer vision or machine learning What we offer Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role We publish a lot of original evidence about AI search: a quarterly industry report, a public Index, and findings from our own research team. Right now each piece reaches the market on its own, and nobody owns the story that connects them. We're hiring a Communications Lead to own that story. You'll decide the few ideas Peec should be known for, write and edit the work that carries them, and keep them consistent across research, founder comms, press, events, social and campaigns. This is a senior individual contributor role based in Berlin. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with our founders, our product marketer, and our research and content team. What you'll do Decide what Peec is known for. Pick the two or three ideas we want to own, the evidence behind each, and how the story develops quarter to quarter. Write it down so the rest of the company can repeat it. Turn research into stories. Work with the research team to find what in the data our audience will care about most, then carry it out: the report intro, the founder post, the journalist brief, the stage premise. Same evidence, told differently for each audience. Shape our social strategy. You set what Peec and our founders talk about on social and how each story runs across LinkedIn and our other channels. The social and content team runs the channels day to day. Work with product marketing so launches and the brand story say the same thing. Write and edit the highest-stakes work yourself. Founder and expert pieces, press materials, campaign copy and research comms. Brief writers and producers on the rest, and hold every contributor to the same bar. Run founder and expert communications. Talking points, interview prep, opinion pieces, stage remarks and founder posts on LinkedIn, with honest feedback afterwards. Make our founders and experts consistently good on the record. Lead press and publisher strategy. Bring the news judgment, angles and briefing materials, and pitch journalists yourself. Treat independent coverage and sponsored placements differently. Make Peec citable in AI search. We help marketing teams see and improve how AI search talks about them. Our own story should be the best-cited example in the category, and you own how ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini describe Peec. What we're looking for You've led an integrated launch at a B2B tech company, taking original research or a complex product to a clear story shipped across channels. You can walk us from raw evidence to final assets: what you wrote, what you commissioned, where the story changed and what you refused to claim. You write fast, in many formats, and in someone else's voice when needed. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear. You are comfortable with data. Given a set of metrics, you can say which story holds up to a sceptical reader and which one doesn't. You've pitched journalists yourself and landed coverage. You've built the function rather than only contributed. Early or growth stage, first or second in seat. You build your own tools. AI is part of how you draft, monitor and research, and you can show us your setup and where you stop letting it write for you. You work directly with founders, make decisions and ship.

jobs.title: Director of Procurement & Trading
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. The Role This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading : fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly. You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space. You report directly to the C level and sit on the commercial and operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement. The core purpose of this role is to build one buying strategy that combines three things: Spot trading , run as a repeatable system with a regular market-coverage schedule and clear KPIs; Strategic buying , where you negotiate allocations, framework agreements and terms with Tier-1 manufacturers and develop private-label and direct-from-factory categories; Supply planning , where you set the mix of spot, contract and stock and keep price and inventory risk under control. Each part on its own is not enough. The job is to make them work together so that Andercore buys at the right price, secures supply when the market tightens, and never holds stock it cannot sell. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right. Working with design delivered as code At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review. This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening. Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools they use, you'll turn what each review teaches us into shared components, conventions, tests and agent instructions. Over time the whole practice becomes more predictable, and each new branch arrives closer to production-ready. Roles and collaboration Software development roles are blurring more than ever. This role reports to product design, with API and data-layer guidance from our control plane engineering lead. You must be attuned to the perspectives of both UX/Design and Engineering, acting as a bridge between the goals and priorities of both sides, while ultimately deferring to UX/design partners on matters of style, copy, and information architecture. In practice: when a designer's branch makes a choice about layout, copy or flow, you protect the intent and fix the implementation. When the implementation can't support the intent, because of performance, data shape or maintainability, you say so early and bring options rather than quietly changing the design. What you'll do Review designer-authored merge requests and bring them to production quality: structure, types, tests, accessibility, performance, and both light and dark themes. Turn one-off UI from fast iteration into shared, documented components in our design system and Storybook, and migrate the apps onto them. Make data-dense views hold up at real scale. jobs.title: Social Media Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description: ZEAL Network SE ist ein führender internationaler Anbieter von Online-Lotterieprodukten und seit über 20 Jahren mit Marken wie LOTTO24 und Tipp24 aktiv. Als Deutschlands größter digitaler Lotterieanbieter und vertrauenswürdiger Partner von ONCE in Spanien gestalten wir mit Leidenschaft die Zukunft des Lotterieerlebnisses. Traumautoverlosung ist eine der neuesten und aufregendsten Marken von ZEAL. Sie macht den Traum vom eigenen Wunschauto greifbar: mit einem Ticket sichern sich Spielende die Chance auf ein exklusives Fahrzeug. Gleichzeitig unterstützt jede Teilnahme soziale Projekte, sodass aus der Gewinnchance ein echter sozialer Mehrwert entsteht. Die Traumautoverlosung verbindet den Nervenkitzel des Gewinnens mit einer bedeutenden sozialen Auswirkung und spiegelt damit ZEALs Engagement für Innovation und soziale Verantwortung wider. Sie bietet den Teilnehmenden mehr als nur ein Spiel - die Chance, Gutes zu tun und gleichzeitig groß zu träumen. Deine Aufgaben: Du baust unsere Community auf Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und weiteren Social-Media-Kanälen aktiv aus, förderst den Austausch und sorgst für eine lebendige Interaktion mit unserer Zielgruppe. Du bist die Stimme unserer Marke in Social Media und sorgst für eine authentische, einheitliche und wiedererkennbare Kommunikation. Du entwickelst kreative, plattformgerechte Content-Formate rund um unsere Traumautos, die Welt der Autoverlosungen und unseren Gründer. Du produzierst eigenständig und spontan Social-Media-Content, beispielsweise direkt vor Ort in unserer Traumgarage – vor oder hinter der Kamera. Du verantwortest die Veröffentlichung unserer organischen Inhalte, analysierst deren Performance und optimierst unsere Content-Strategie kontinuierlich. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Paid Social Manager zusammen, um organische und bezahlte Inhalte optimal aufeinander abzustimmen. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Content Creatorn und Influencern auf und entwickelst unser Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter. Du vertrittst unsere Marke auf Events und in der Automotive-Szene, knüpfst Kontakte und stärkst unsere Präsenz innerhalb der Community. Was du mitbringst: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media Management, idealerweise für eine Marke mit einer aktiven und engagierten Community. Du bist kreativ, entwickelst kontinuierlich neue Content-Ideen, erkennst Trends frühzeitig und setzt diese schnell um. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für plattformgerechten Content auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube und weißt, welche Formate die jeweilige Zielgruppe begeistern. Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Produktion und Bearbeitung von Short-Form-Videos mit dem Smartphone und fühlst dich bei Bedarf auch vor der Kamera wohl. Du arbeitest datengetrieben, analysierst relevante Social-Media-KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du hast bereits mit Creatorn oder Influencern zusammengearbeitet oder bringst ein gutes Gespür für den Aufbau langfristiger Partnerschaften mit. Du begeisterst dich für Autos und die Automotive-Szene oder bist motiviert, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Gewinnspielen, Verlosungen, E-Commerce oder anderen Community-getriebenen Geschäftsmodellen mit. Erste Kontakte in der Automotive- und Creator-Szene, Erfahrung mit Tools wie CapCut oder Premiere wären ein Plus Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Kontinuierliche persönliche Weiterentwicklung, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 €, das du in deine berufliche Entwicklung investieren kannst. Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung – kein Mikromanagement, sondern echtes Vertrauen in deine Fähigkeiten, hervorragende Ergebniss

jobs.description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋 Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly. This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them. In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄 Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets. Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention. Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio. Establish AI-native ways of working across the team - embedding modern tooling, setting standards for how AI accelerates discovery, delivery, and decision-making, and ensuring the team operates at the leading edge of product practice. Partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Commercial Finance to deliver scalable, reliable distribution products that meet the needs of TMCs, OBTs, and other partners. Represent Product in commercial and partner discussions, acting as a credible voice on capability, roadmap, and strategic direction with senior internal and external stakeholders. Drive a culture of clear prioritisation, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement - ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. jobs.description: Trust unlocks our greatest potential. For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution. What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’. What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight team as an Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight Lead? Reporting to the Head of Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight, you will coordinate thorough assessments of new Embedded Banking Partners to evaluate their financial crime controls, with emphasis on outsourced processes. You must understand their Operating Model, including systems, processes, and sub-contractors. After onboarding, you will monitor these partners' financial crime controls, assess risks using ClearBank’s taxonomy and relevant data, and ensure compliance with the Oversight model, including leading governance sessions. jobs.title: Senior Collections Advisor
jobs.description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. We're looking for an experienced individual to fill the role of Senior Collections Advisor. This position requires an important balance of both credit and conduct risk as we focus on delivering the right outcomes for our customers based on their individual circumstances, always. You will be working alongside as part of small but rapidly expanding team in our Milton Keynes office, this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our Milton Keynes office with flexibility on the other 2. There will also be a requirement to attend our central London office once a month (fully expensed). The ideal candidate will have excellent attention to detail and be comfortable following documented procedures consistently ensuring that all customers are treated fairly and receive the appropriate outcomes. Tasks also include updating account details, maintaining accurate records, and escalating cases to senior staff if necessary. There will also be a requirement to identify and support customers who may shows signs of vulnerability. jobs.description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The Opportunity Our Platform engineering team is growing up. Two engineering teams, Developer Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, build the foundations every 9fin engineer and product squad relies on. We now need a senior Product Manager to sit across both and bring product discipline to how the platform is shaped. Today, Platform runs on speed and engineering instinct. You will help it work more like a product team. You will own the upfront work of problem definition, internal user research, prioritisation and success criteria, so engineers can focus on building the right things. Engineers are your customers: you will interview them, compare solutions, synthesise what you learn, and turn it into a clear roadmap. You will also own quarterly strategy and priorities planning across both teams, balancing operational and support demand against building the self-service platform of the future. You will work closely with two engineering leads and their teams, and partner with product squads across the organisation who depend on the platform. Day-to-day triage will largely stay with platform engineers, so you can focus on the decisions that matter most. This is a high-autonomy role with direct access to engineering leadership and real scope to define what “platform as a product” means at 9fin. You will also make the value of platform work visible, using data to show where it makes teams more effective and celebrating the wins. Key responsibilities: Product Strategy & Execution Strategy: Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for the platform product squad. Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from engineering surveys, interviews, and usage data to craft clear problem statements, articulating root causes in a structured way. Discovery: Run structured discovery with internal engineering customers - interviews, usage analysis, survey synthesis - to understand developer workflows, identify friction, and build confidence before investing. Impact driven: Define and align the team around key outcomes and effectively prioritise across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, distinguishing urgent requests from long-term investments that benefit multiple teams. Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics that capture platform value and make the impact of platform work visible across the engineering org. Team Leadership & Communication Team Success: Create a collaborative environment across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, providing wider context and clear goals so engineers can do their best work. Celebrate platform wins and build a culture where engineers trust the roadmap. Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complicated technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Influence: Build strong relationships to empower your squads to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside your team - including product and feature teams who depend on you

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Travel is essential, whether it's visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career-defining trip. Yet over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we're rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we're simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel. The Role As Senior Product Designer, you’ll help solve a uniquely rewarding challenge: making travel disruptions easier for everyone involved. When plans change unexpectedly, travellers need fast, clear answers, while the businesses that sold them the trip need to stay in control. You’ll design our AI support product end-to-end, shaping the experience for both the travel businesses using Duffel (B2B) and the travellers they serve (B2C). Working closely with product, engineering, and operations, you’ll champion design across Duffel, helping define what great looks like and elevating the craft of our products as a whole. To thrive in this role, you’ll bring experience designing complex products from start to finish and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring those ideas to life. What you'll be doing Own end-to-end design for our AI support product, from discovery and flows to prototypes and shipped software, in a product where airline rules, payments and customer expectations all collide. Run discovery with customers and the travellers they serve, and turn needs from multiple stakeholders into clear, prioritised requirements. Be the voice of design at Duffel: set and uphold the quality bar across craft, accessibility and consistency, and raise it in every review. Work shoulder to shoulder with Product Managers and engineers to take designs through to delivery, then learn from real usage and feedback quickly. Explain the why behind every design decision, welcome challenge from anyone, and change your mind when the evidence says so. Design how AI and people work together: what the AI should do, when it hands over to a human, and how users understand, trust and correct it. Bring ideas from other products and industries to Duffel, and share them so the whole team's design thinking improves. What we're looking for 5+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows you've taken a complex product from problem to shipped outcome and can say what changed because of it. Strong craft across interaction, visual and systems design: you ship the states, edge cases and accessibility, not only the happy path. Experience working with several stakeholder groups at once, ideally both business customers and end consumers, and a clear method for turning their conflicting needs into decisions. Experience designing AI, conversational or support products, and an understanding of what makes them hard: uncertainty, failure states, trust and handover to humans. A close working relationship with engineers and PMs, including prototyping in code or with AI tools where it speeds up learning. A collaborative mindset with a strong point of view: you push back with evidence, take feedback well and can articulate the why behind any design. The confidence to hold a quality bar and speak for design across the company. You influence without authority and you're happy to set the example. What you'll be working on Designing the experience of an AI support agent that answers travellers and hands over to our travel support team when it should. Defining the patterns for AI behaviour: when it acts, asks, escalates or defers, and how users see what it did and why. Building tools for the businesses on Duffel to review, correct and trust what the AI does on their behalf. Helping other teams with their design needs when they ask, and sometimes when they don't yet know they have one. Sharing design progress, rationale and open questions weekly with product, engineering and operations, Why

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description: 🚀 Why Midnite? Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players. We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today. Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started. We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading. Not your grandad’s bookie. 👀 The Role Title: Finance Manager Team: Finance Location: UK Hybrid; London or Leeds area preferred for hybrid collaboration. Wider UK candidates considered. Number of Positions: 2 As Finance Manager, you’ll report to Reshma Nangpal and work closely with the broader finance team, including other Finance Managers, to deliver accurate, timely month-end accounting and financial control. This is a hands-on role covering bank and PSP reconciliations, sportsbook and casino revenue accounting, gaming duties and revenue-share payments. You’ll partner with Data, Compliance and Commercial teams, strengthen scalable processes and support Midnite’s growth across entities and markets. We’re hiring two people, with flexibility for mid-level and more senior accountants. You will: Deliver key aspects of the monthly close accurately and on time, including accounts payable, supplier invoices, staff expenses and company credit card reconciliations. Perform and review bank reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, post bank fees and update month-end FX rates. Own PSP reconciliations and monthly journals, matching settlement and transactional data to accounting records. Maintain reconciliations for deferred revenue, player balances, prepayments and fixed assets, and accrue key supplier costs. Prepare sportsbook and casino revenue journals and reconcile revenue and cost of sales to source data, including promotional deductions and adjustments. Verify and accrue contractual revenue-share payments, share monthly data with casino suppliers and reconcile it to internal records; manage international partner revenue-share receivables and invoicing. Calculate and accrue General Betting Duty, Remote Gaming Duty, the Horse Racing Levy, Statutory Levy and Economic Crime Levy. Prepare the month-end cash report, support management reporting and variance analysis, reconcile marketing costs and post interest journals for the user acquisition credit facility. Help maintain the financial model with FP&A and Data, aligning reporting with forecasts and KPIs and supporting gross-margin and customer-profitability analysis. Maintain robust controls and documentation, review balance sheets, liaise with external accountants and auditors, and assess accounting treatments for new deals as Midnite expands internationally. Improve workflows through automation and AI, collaborating with other Finance Managers and cross-functional teams to deliver accurate, timely financial insight. The next Midniter: Is at least part-qualified (e.g. ACCA, CIMA or ACA) and actively working toward full qualification, or is fully qualified and looking for a more senior opening. Has hands-on month-end accounting and financial control experience, including reconciliations and revenue processes. Is familiar with PSPs and high-volume transactional data. Understands UK GAAP/IFRS and their application to revenue and cost accounting, alongside robust controls and audit-ready records. Brings gambling industry experience as a strong advantage, not a requirement; gaming duty calculation experience is also a plus. Genuinely wants to work in gambling and learns unfamiliar topics through proactive research and technical questioning. Brings commercial acumen, can assess deals from financial and accounting perspect

jobs.title: VP Sales
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Your Role We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance. You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers. Key Responsibilities Win and close contracts: Lead high-value deals with governments and large space organisations, from first conversation through to signature. Own the full sales cycle: Sourcing, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close - across every stage. Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators. Set commercial strategy: Shape and execute NewOrbit's sales approach for government and enterprise customers. Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events. Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable. Report to leadership: Own pipeline, forecasting, and deal status reporting to the board. Grow the function: Build out a wider sales team as the business scales. Fundamental Requirements Satellite sales experience (required): Direct, hands-on experience selling satellites specifically, across the full sales process. Current, up-to-date knowledge of the satellite customer landscape. Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments. Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire. Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry. Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale. Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be. AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt. We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use. In this role, you'll... Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users. Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way. Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward. Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all. Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations

jobs.description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. jobs.title: People Ops (HR & Recruitment) - Intern
jobs.description: ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds. Founded in 2021, we’re a 65 -person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries , growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure. 💡 Overview As our People Ops Intern, you'll work at the heart of the People team, supporting both People Operations and Talent Acquisition. You'll own real projects end to end, be trusted to bring your own ideas, and see how a fast-scaling international startup actually runs behind the scenes, across HR admin, office life, employer brand, tech events and AI automation. 🧠 What you'll work on: People Operations & HR admin Support the day-to-day of an international team across France, the US, remote Europe, as well as parts of Asia and Australia: employment contracts, policies, employee benefits, onboarding and offboarding logistics. Become our go-to expert on Deel (our global HR platform): research country-specific rules, maintain workflows and chase down answers. Help handle individual employee cases that require research - dig into policies, employment contracts or local labour law and summarise what you find into something actionable. Office, community & culture Take ownership of our Paris office: visitors, room bookings, day-to-day logistics. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Your mission At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible. As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib. Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products. What you'll do Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality. Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen , ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products. Champion an AI-first approach , exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently. Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices , working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization. Drive technical alignment across engineering teams , fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems. Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers , fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Who you are If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next teammate if you: You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture. Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers. Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes. Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus. Now, it would be fantastic if you: Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams. Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications. Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance. jobs.title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
jobs.description: Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale. You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight. ➡️ What you'll do Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery. Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan. Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution. Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned. Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers. ➡️ What we're looking for Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy. Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa). Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions. Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick. Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience. Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus). ➡️ What we can offer you Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale. A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development. A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work. How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed. Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan. ➡️ Your future manager Your manager will be Marie Pouzin , Head of Finance Transformation. jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager Italy
jobs.description: [OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ). [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Country Support (Italy) to help shape Qonto’s strategy in Italy and turn local priorities into action. Working with Fanny , our Strategy Director, and Italy’s country leadership, you’ll combine market insights, strategic planning and hands-on project leadership to support growth in the Italian market. You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech. ➡️ What you’ll do Understand the Italian market: Analyze market trends, customer needs, regulation and competition to anticipate their impact on Qonto and identify opportunities for growth. Shape the country strategy and plan: Work with Italy’s country leadership to identify opportunities and define and refresh the country strategy and priorities, connecting local opportunities with Qonto’s wider strategic plan. Track progress against the plan with the Finance Business Partner. Develop the strategy per segment: Analyze the market and customer base to define and refresh strategies for different customer segments and identify new business opportunities. Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Assess the potential, scope, business case and strategic rationale of key initiatives supporting Italy’s priorities and OKRs. Lead or coordinate execution where needed, and hand projects over to country teams when ready. Projects will vary with country priorities and could include exploring a company-creation offering. Strong stakeholder management is essential. ➡️ What we’re looking for Experience: You have around 4–5 years or more of relevant experience in strategic project management, consulting and/or a hands-on role in a startup or company. Consulting experience is useful but not required; experience in banking, payments or fintech is a plus, not a prerequisite. Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans. Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders. Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward. Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery. Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with. Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required. Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

Votre rôle est central : fédérer les équipes, développer les performances et garantir une expérience client à la hauteur de nos marques. VOS MISSIONS FÉDÉRER, PILOTER, PERFORMER ! MANAGER ET DÉVELOPPER LES TALENTS Encadrer, animer et fédérer les équipes commerciales VN/VO des différents sites. Accompagner les conseillers commerciaux sur le terrain et développer leurs compétences. Organiser l'activité, fixer les priorités et assurer le suivi des résultats. Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des collaborateurs. DÉVELOPPER LA PERFORMANCE COMMERCIALE Déployer la stratégie commerciale en collaboration avec le Directeur de Plaque. Piloter les objectifs de ventes, de marges et de produits périphériques. Analyser les indicateurs et mettre en œuvre les actions nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs. Optimiser la gestion, la rotation et la rentabilité des stocks VN/VO. Renforcer les synergies commerciales entre les concessions. Veiller au respect des standards Toyota et Lexus. Développer la satisfaction et la fidélisation de nos clients. VOTRE PROFIL UN LEADER DE TERRAIN, UNE CULTURE DU RÉSULTAT. Vous disposez d'une expérience réussie en management commercial , idéalement en tant que Chef des Ventes VN/VO dans la distribution automobile. Vous savez conjuguer exigence de performance, proximité avec vos équipes et sens du collectif. Ce qui fera la différence : Un leadership naturel et une réelle capacité à fédérer. Une solide maîtrise des enjeux économiques et commerciaux d'une concession. Un véritable talent pour accompagner et faire progresser les collaborateurs. De la rigueur, de l'autonomie et un excellent esprit d'analyse. Une forte orientation résultats et satisfaction client. Une expérience du management multisite constituera un atout. UNE RÉELLE AUTONOMIE La possibilité de développer vos équipes, de prendre des initiatives et de contribuer directement aux résultats. UNE RELATION DIRECTE AVEC LA DIRECTION Une collaboration étroite avec le Directeur de Plaque pour porter la stratégie et les ambitions commerciales du groupe. L'EXIGENCE DE DEUX MARQUES DE RÉFÉRENCE Toyota et Lexus, deux univers complémentaires qui placent la qualité et la satisfaction client au premier plan.
