jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one modelling team Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs. Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models. Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance. Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers. Stay close to the real world We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand. You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions. Who You Are You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use. You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers. You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations. Technical Requirements Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
jobs.description: RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale. Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery Job Description   Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.     What you’ll be doing Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks. Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization. Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources. Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data. Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor). Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers. Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making. Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing. What you must have Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning. A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable. Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models). Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.). Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation. Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms. Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch) Get some bonus points PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience. Publications at top-tier conferences. Experience in managing a software team. Ability to write production-level code in modern C++ RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Electra</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.</span></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Role</span></strong></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Electra.aero is seeking an experienced&nbsp;<strong>Senior Airspace Engineer</strong> to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;

jobs.description: Important Information This role is a full time, permanent, in office position. Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC Contract: 6 month FTC About Nivoda Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry. We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition. The Role As a Junior Logistics Executive, you'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care. This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous. If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment. Operational Support: Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently Precision & Security: Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence. Process Improvement: Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly. Growth Mindset: Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication. What you'll need for this entry-level role: Strong Attention to Detail Ability to repack/handle goods Team-Oriented Mindset Basic Administrative Skills Trustworthiness & Discretion Highly desirable Experience working in high-security logistics environments, preferably with luxury goods, jewelry, or diamonds. Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures. Proficiency in basic logistics software or ERP systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite, or similar). Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Physically fit and able to handle small manual tasks as part of the shipment handling process. A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization. What you'll get: 💸Competitive compensation 🍎Free lunch 🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning 🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. jobs.title: Data Officer
jobs.description: Als Data Officer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ondersteunen van het productontwikkelingsproces door technische gegevens over grondstoffen en verpakkingscomponenten te verzamelen en in te voeren in het Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) en Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systeem van het bedrijf. De functie omvat regelmatige communicatie met leveranciers om informatie op te vragen, de volledigheid van gegevens te controleren en ervoor te zorgen dat alle artikelgegevens accuraat en up-to-date zijn. Deze functie is ideaal voor iemand met veel oog voor detail en interesse in cosmetica, gegevensbeheer of productontwikkeling.   Ons Data team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Regulatory Affairs. De afdeling bestaat uit twee Regulatory Affairs Specialisten, vier Regulatory Affairs Officers. en twee Data Officers. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de Manager Regulatory Affairs. MISSION Het bij leveranciers opvragen en verzamelen van technische gegevens, specificaties en documentatie voor grondstoffen en verpakkingen. De door leveranciers ingediende documenten controleren op volledigheid en juistheid (bijv. INCI-lijsten, veiligheidsinformatiebladen, specificaties, certificaten, enz. Nauwkeurig invoeren en bijwerken van materiaal- en verpakkingsgegevens in het PLM- en ERP-systeem. Bijhouden van openstaande leveranciersinformatie en indien nodig opvolgen. Ondersteunen van interne teams (Innovation & Research, Regulatory Affairs en Purchase) met nauwkeurige gegevensbeschikbaarheid. Assisteren bij het handhaven van datakwaliteitsnormen en documentatietemplates. Meewerken aan basis PLM-gegevensaudits en verbeteringsinitiatieven. YOU Een MBO-diploma scheikunde, farmakunde, verpakkingstechniek of een verwant vakgebied is een pré; Enige ervaring met gegevensinvoer, productdocumentatie of leverancierscoördinatie heeft de voorkeur; Sterk oog voor detail en nauwkeurigheid van gegevens; Goede organisatorische- en tijdmanagementvaardigheden; Duidelijke en professionele communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk in het Nederlands en Engels; Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken in een multifunctioneel team; OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een duurzaamheidsbewuste werkgever; Reiskostenvergoeding; 27 vrije dagen per jaar (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband); Een goede pensioenregeling; Salarisschaal: € 2.700 - € 3.200; Aandacht voor jouw mentale welzijn door onbeperkt toegang tot OpenUp; Deelname aan groepslessen bij Personel Fitness Soest; En nooit meer een ‘bad hair day’ dankzij de personeelskortingen op de gehele Keune collectie! KEUNE Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap het hart van alles is wat we doen. Ons verhaal begon in 1922 in Amsterdam. Keune is een van de snelstgroeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden Keune-producten wereldwijd ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en gedistribueerd naar meer dan 90 landen. jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities. jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated. Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end. As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems. You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably. Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components. Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable. Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery. Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests. Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve. Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers. Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits. Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development. Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code. Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control. Proven experience designing

jobs.title: Stage Office Management (mbo/hbo)
jobs.description: Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt? Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair Office Management die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen. Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee! Over Zibber Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren. Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen. De rol Binnen de stage Office Management werk je nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt. Denk aan: Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten. Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering. Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt. Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken. Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën. En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen! Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant. De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken. Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven. Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid. Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage. Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school. Starten in januari of februari 2027! Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage. Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je: Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht. Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen. Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren. Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker! jobs.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
jobs.description: Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting. Jouw rol Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder: Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen. Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning. Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole. Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor. Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften. jobs.title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie

jobs.title: Projekt-/Finanzcontroller (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Das Unternehmen Unser Auftraggeber ist eine erfolgreiche, wachsende Wohnungsbaugesellschaft im Eigentum eines Landkreises. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert moderne Wohnungsbauprojekte in der Region und verbindet unternehmerisches Handeln mit einem gesellschaftlich wichtigen Auftrag. Zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmenscontrollings suchen wir einen erfahrenen Projekt-/Finanzcontroller (m/w/d) Wohnungsbau | Eigenverantwortung | Sicherer Arbeitsplatz der seinen Verantwortungsbereich eigenständig gestaltet und als kompetenter Ansprechpartner der Geschäftsführung agiert. Gestalte das Controlling eines kommunalen Wohnungsbauunternehmens! Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen analysieren, sondern mit Deinen Auswertungen und Empfehlungen unternehmerische Entscheidungen aktiv mitgestalten? Du schätzt eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Sicherheit eines kommunalen Unternehmens? Dann bietet Dir diese Position eine interessante berufliche Perspektive. In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst Du das gesamte Unternehmens- und Projektcontrolling und entwickelst die bestehenden Strukturen und Instrumente kontinuierlich weiter. Deine Aufgaben – Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum Unternehmens- und Finanzcontrolling Du verantwortest eigenständig das Unternehmens- und Immobiliencontrolling und entwickelst dessen Strukturen und Instrumente weiter. Du erstellst Wirtschafts-, Finanz- und Liquiditätsplanungen sowie regelmäßige Forecasts. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen, Soll-Ist-Vergleiche und Abweichungsanalysen. Du bereitest aussagekräftige Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung auf und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Du erkennst wirtschaftliche Risiken und Abweichungen frühzeitig und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Projektverantwortlichen geeignete Steuerungsmaßnahmen. Du unterstützt bei Jahresabschlussarbeiten und arbeitest mit dem Rechnungswesen sowie externen Wirtschaftsprüfern zusammen. jobs.description: About 42 Wolfsburg / Berlin 42 Wolfsburg/Berlin is a nonprofit association running two innovative, higher education coding schools—one in Wolfsburg and one in Berlin—training the next generation of software engineers through peer learning. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: <h3><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h3> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p class="p1">As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the&nbsp;limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we&nbsp;believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting&nbsp;field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to&nbsp;deliver impactful AI research.&nbsp;We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference,&nbsp;world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate&nbsp;them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>The Team</h3> <p>Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.</p> <p>We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.</p> <p>Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/publications/">papers</a> or an article on our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/posts/">blog</a>. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <h3>Responsibilities and Duties</h3> <ul> <li>Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them &amp; evaluate results.</li> <li>Prepare, submit &amp; present your work to AI conferences and workshops.</li> <li>Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.</li> <li>Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcor

Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast. We're a software engineering team as much as an infrastructure team: we write the code that runs our platform, not just the configuration around it. When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working. The opportunity Day to day, you'll build and manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and writing the software and tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production. Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. jobs.description: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Quotient is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented operational leader to run the management, process control, governance and quality leadership of its research tissue bank. You will also be the central point of coordination between laboratory teams, Facilities, Procurement and Logistics, Project Leads and Data Infrastructure, so that colleagues get timely access to suitable samples with full end-to-end traceability.</p> <p>This role combines ownership of the tissue bank with practical oversight of delivery. Success means reliable, well-organised inventory and chain-of-custody records, timely availability of samples for research, compliance with internal SOPs and HTA regulations, and effective resolution of any sample-related incidents.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Biobank governance and strategy: </strong>Own Quotient's research tissue bank strategy, aligning governance, capacity, resources and operating systems with the research portfolio, and recommend investment and improvements. Report sample availability, integrity, traceability, compliance risks and incident trends to leadership.</li> <li><strong>HTA compliance: </strong>Act as the HTA Designated Individual for Quotient's research licence, supervising licensed activities and making sure that staff, premises, storage and procedures meet HTA requirements. Apply independent judgement to complex sample-use decisions, balancing scientific priorities with donor permissions, sample availability and governance requirements, and obtain specialist advice or further approvals where needed.</li> <li><strong>Sample acquisition and custody: </strong>Own custody controls from handover at receipt through registration, storage, retrieval, distribution and disposal, including manifests, shipment conditions, acceptance checks, handovers and receipt acknowledgements. Set requirements for human tissue shipments and approve the release of inbound and outbound shipments, working with logistics colleagues who handle couriers and documentation. Provide cover for sample receipt and shipping, directly or through trained delegates.</li> <li><strong>Inventory systems and traceability: </strong>Integrate sample inventory with LIMS and ELN records, keeping identifiers, parent–derivative relationships, quantities, locations, status and movement histories accurate through timely updates, controlled access and periodic reconciliation. Inbolt makes it take minutes. Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents. We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role: You'll join the finance team as Finance Ops , reporting to Jean-François, our VP Finance. It's the right seat for someone who wants to see the whole finance function of a scaling industrial company. 🎯 Responsibilities Controlling & reporting Own the month-end close: accuracy of cost allocations, accruals, prepaids and intercompany across our French, US and Japanese entities Analyze financial performance against budget and targets; explain variances to the VP Finance and leadership Prepare the monthly reporting package (P&L, cash, KPIs) for management, the board and investors Contribute to budgeting and forecasting cycles Operations & cash Invoice customers and monitor collections; follow up on overdue payments with Sales and Deployment Prepare supplier and payroll-related bank payments Track down and collect missing supporting documents (invoices, POs, expense receipts) and drive the team to keep them clean Building the function Improve internal finance processes and tooling, including using AI tools to automate collection, matching and reconciliation work Take over bookkeeping (AP, AR, bank, accruals, prepaids) from our external accountant over the next 12–18 months Support audit, tax and grant-related requests (CIR, BPI, etc.) 🔎 Preferred experience 3–4 years of experience in controlling, accounting or audit: ideally a mix (e.g. audit or expertise-comptable followed by an in-house role) Experience in a startup/fast-paced environment Degree in Finance, Accounting or Business (DCG, DSCG, Master CCA or equivalent) Solid understanding of French GAAP, financial statements and month-end mechanics Comfortable with financial analysis and budget tracking Advanced Excel / Google Sheets Familiarity with accounting or ERP software (Pennylane, Sage, NetSuite or similar) Fluent in French and English: both required, as you'll work with our US and Japanese teams Experience in leveraging or implementing AI solutions to improve and streamline financial processes ✍️ Position details Team: Finance Contract: CDI, full-time Location: Paris (12 Rue Vivienne, 75002) Work mode: 3 days minimum on site per week Start date: ASAP Package: 📈 stock options and 🩺 health coverage, on top of the benefits below Why join Inbolt Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM and Bosch, across 200+ factories on three continents. Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise. An international team: Paris, Detroit and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners. A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand. Benefits We're building our benefits location by location, so they fit local needs and practices in each country where we operate. 📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit 🤝 Team-building events & off-sites 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy 🍽️ Lunch expenses covered ✈️ Customer site visits in real factories and more.... jobs.description: Tu es gestionnaire de paie et tu as envie de rejoindre un éditeur de logiciel ? Alassio constitue son équipe Support et recrute son ou sa Spécialiste Support Paie ! Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Ta réactivité et la clarté de tes réponses conditionnent leur confiance dans Alassio dès leurs premières semaines en production. En accompagnant les gestionnaires de paie dans leur pratique quotidienne du logiciel, tu contribues directement à la qualité du produit , et tu montes en compétences sur toute la paie et sur notre outil. 🧭 Ton parcours et tes missions Tu te formes sur le produit, sur la paie telle qu'Alassio la calcule et sur les process de l'équipe Tu prends le relais d'Alassio Intelligence , notre agent IA qui apporte la première réponse, quand un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain : tu réponds sur Intercom aux questions d'utilisation de l'outil, de paramétrage de dossier et de paie courante Tu gagnes en autonomie et tiens nos standards de service : première réponse en moins de 5 minutes, satisfaction des cabinets supérieure à 98 % Tu qualifies chaque demande et tu l'escalades quand il le faut, avec tous les éléments utiles : aux Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN pour les cas complexes de paie et de DSN, à l'équipe Tech pour les bugs Tu contribues aux contenus d'aide et à la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence, pour rendre les cabinets plus autonomes Tu portes la voix des utilisateurs en remontant au Product des retours structurés Tu testes les nouvelles fonctionnalités avant leur mise en production 🤝 Ton environnement Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. jobs.title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
jobs.description: Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english) Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London) Level: Programme Manager senior Team: Client Delivery Contract: Permanent Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one. Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams. Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting. Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery. Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads. Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE. Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards. Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include: Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence. Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business. Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched. Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre. jobs.title: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. About the Role This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses. You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound. Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies. jobs.title: Combustion Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuellable in orbit - and potentially fly humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We are seeking a talented Combustion Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for contributing to designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines. Key Responsibilities Provide support to global combustor fluidic system development through application of both theory and/or CFD. Drive and/or contribute to injector design and optimisation against combustor requirements and design intent using theory and/or CFD. Support definition of instrumentation for hot-fire testing and assist with post-test data interpretation and CFD/model correlation. Reduce and analyse hot-fire test data to derive performance and combustion-stability metrics, and maintain associated data processing tools Support design reviews with clear technical justification of analysis methods, assumptions, and margins. What we would love to see from you Minimum of a Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 3+ years of relevant/equivalent experience in combustion, propulsion, or reacting-flow engineering. Solid foundation in bi-liquid rocket combustion processes. Strong background in reacting-flow CFD (e.g. ANSYS, OpenFOAM, Converge) using RANS and/or LES Strong scripting and data-analysis ability in Python or similar Exposure to liquid rocket injector CFD. Experience with combustion of cryogenic propellants. Familiarity with combustion instability, thermoacoustics, or uncertainty quantification is beneficial. Experience supporting or participating in hot-fire test campaigns is beneficial. Skills and Behaviours Structured and methodical approach to problem solving. Demonstrated rigour: checks reference calculations, documents assumptions, and treats a discrepancy between prediction and test as a problem to be solved rather than dismissed. Ability to work under technical uncertainty and iterate models as test data becomes available. Clear written and verbal communication of assumptions, methods, and conclusions. Comfort working in cross-disciplinary teams across thermo-mechanical, systems, and test engineering. Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail. Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork. Why you should join us! jobs.title: Image Processing Intern: AI-Assisted Tools for CalVal
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. In this internship, you’ll explore how AIT captures and routine onboard imagery can support optical performance testing and radiometric calibration, and turn that work into an evaluated engineering prototype. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review DSNU, radiometric calibration, and relevant EVP processing and CAL/VAL practices. Work with EVP engineers to identify suitable routine images, metadata, and reference calibration data; document data limitations and provenance. Prepare a reproducible dataset and establish reference baselines, including a holdout evaluation strategy that avoids tuning and testing on the same acquisitions. Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior. Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior. Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases. Package the workflow as a prototype script or notebook with plots, quality checks, and an auditable record of inputs, parameters, and outputs. Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use. The intern will gain experience in: Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging. Push-broom image characteristics and PRNU/DSNU correction. Applied optimization and, where appropriate, machine learning for image processing. Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment. Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams. Must Haves: Student in engineering, applied physics, remote sensing, image processing, data science, or a related field. Fundamentals of signal or image processing and a strong interest in Earth observation. Basic programming skills in Python and comfort working with scientific data. Analytical mindset, rigor, and ability to document assumptions and limitations. Interest in calibration, validation, sensor behavior, or image quality assessment. Nice to Haves: Exposure to satellite imagery or remote-sensing data. Experience with optimization, statistical estimation, or machine-learning evaluation. Familiarity with image-analysis libraries and scientific Python tools. Understanding of radiometric calibration or data-quality assessment. What Can We Offer? You will join a stimulating environment, surrounded by passionate engineers, conducive to learning, innovation, and personal and professional development — and help build the future of space infrastructure. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law. jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance. Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements. Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules. Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics. Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions. Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution. Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions. You’ll work from our Amsterdam office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech. Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules. Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls. Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation. Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale. Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners. Preferred Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd. We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie. Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand. Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur. Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Dat lees je hieronder: “Momenteel loop ik stage bij PharmaPartners. Het is mijn eerste stage en het bevalt me ontzettend goed. Ik werk bij de Customer Support afdeling van eHealth aan mijn eigen opdracht, waarmee ook echt iets gedaan wordt. Je krijgt hier veel vertrouwen en vrijheid om aan je eigen opdracht te werken en initiatief te tonen, maar er is altijd iemand die met je meedenkt. De open en informele sfeer zorgt ervoor dat je bij iedereen terecht kunt met vragen of gewoon voor een praatje, zowel binnen de afdeling als in de rest van de organisatie. Het is een fijne plek om te ontdekken wat je leuk vindt en om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een professionele, maar informele omgeving.” Kristi Imming – Stagiaire Customer Support PharmaPartners maakt software voor de eerstelijns zorg in Nederland, voor huisartsen, apotheken en patiënten. Binnen ons bedrijf hebben wij diverse afdelingen waarvoor we enthousiaste meewerk- en afstudeerstagiaires zoeken. Zoek jij een stage binnen een onze afdelingen, Research & Development, Innovatie, Sales of Support? Lees dan verder! De collega’s van PharmaPartners gaan samen met jou aan de slag om de eerstelijnszorg te verbeteren. Vind jij het als stagiaire leuk om: Met jouw frisse blik een bijdrage te leveren aan de zorg; Een stapje extra te zetten door het beste uit jezelf te halen; Samen met leuke collega’s te streven naar het beste resultaat?; Jezelf te ontwikkelen als professional en als kennishouder in jouw vakgebied?; Jezelf flexibel in te zetten en om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken? En doe je dat allemaal het liefste samen met open, eerlijke en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte, informele organisatie? Dan past een stageplaats bij een van de afdelingen binnen PharmaPartners zeker bij jou. In 2025 gingen 11 stagiaires jou voor! Ben jij de nieuwe stagiaire van 2026? Solliciteer dan snel! Herken jij je hierin? Jij volgt een opleiding richting ICT, Gezondheidszorgtechnologie, Informatica, Commercieel of Management; Jij bent op zoek naar een 3e of 4e jaars stage voor minimaal 4 maanden; Jij bent flexibel inzetbaar, waarbij er bij ons op kantoor in Oosterhout en thuis gewerkt kan worden; Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau; Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus, gedisciplineerd en hebt een flinke dosis lef! En is dit wat je zoekt? Een fijne stage begeleider vanuit PharmaPartners; Een stagevergoeding tussen de 300 en 600 euro!; Vrijheid en de ruimte om je creativiteit te delen en om je eigen opdracht uit te kunnen voeren; De mogelijkheid om je theoretische kennis in de praktijk toe te passen; Een innovatieve en betrokken werkplek waar ideeën en meningen worden gewaardeerd; Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: AI Engineer AivyCare
jobs.description: Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de huisartsenzorg Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare : een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare. Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows. Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen. Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen. Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden. Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je: Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling. Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten. Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code. Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn. Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines. Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider. Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code. Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen. Hybride werken: hybride werken betekent bij ons dat je minimaal 3 á 4 dagen per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.   By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.   At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen.  You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time.  This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved. Experience working in a regulated environment. Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work. A systematic, process-oriented way of working. The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems. A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements. The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed. Bachelor’s degree or higher in enginee

Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren. Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport.
