We need a standout professional who can think outside conventional frameworks - utilizing deep insights, unlock pay transparency, and establishing strong business partnerships to drive exceptional results. This position plays a vital role in ensuring our rewards structures effectively incentivize and motivate our global workforce.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Global Director of Compensation Strategy, this high-impact, visible position is central to aligning our rewards initiatives with HelloFresh’s core pay philosophy, fostering our growth objectives, maintaining market competitiveness, and guaranteeing absolute pay compliance. You will play a foundational role in defining our global rewards strategy and structuring defensible compensation frameworks.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Business Partnership:</strong> Partner closely with HR teams and business executives across Tech and various global divisions, offering a macro perspective on compensation alongside specialist counsel on localized strategies and pay practices.</li> <li><strong>Compensation Program Leadership:</strong> Spearhead ongoing and upcoming strategic rewards initiatives while contributing to the design and rollout of global programs, including pay equity assessments, annual cycles, job architecture, and key talent retention initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Analytics and Insights:</strong> Deliver advanced data-driven modeling and analytics to guide compensation frameworks, ensuring alignment with external market trends and internal equity, particularly when structuring competitive candidate offers.</li> <li><strong>Process and Tool Innovation:</strong> Design and optimize analytical tools, workflows, and dashboard metrics in alignment with global People teams to serve specific business line demands and ensure visibility for leadership and management.</li> <li><strong>Market Intelligence:</strong> Formulate and conduct detailed benchmarking studies to monitor market movements, bridge data deficits, and offer validated recommendations to the business.</li> <li><strong>Advisory &amp; Enablement:</strong> Act as the primary subject matter authority for global rewards frameworks. Create and deliver clear communication materials to educate, enable, and support HR colleagues, line managers, and general employees.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Professional Experience:</strong> 8+ years of dedicated compensation experience, preferably supporting global technology sectors or corporate functions within a fast-moving international ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Influence &amp; Strategy:</strong> A clear passion for the compensation space coupled with a strategic viewpoint and a demonstrated history of influencing, guiding, and counseling HRBPs and senior corporate executives.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Capabilities:</strong> Superior analytical capacity with specialized experience handling complex datasets and building robust financial models (advanced mastery of Google Sheets or Excel is required).</li> <li><strong>Program Development:</strong> Proven experience conceptualizing and introducing broad compensation programs within rapidly shifting business models, balancing attractive employee rewards with corporate fiscal boundaries.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability

It fits a senior creative who's comfortable shaping the approach as they go and consulting directly with senior partners. If you'd rather execute an established process, this isn't the fit. What You'll Own Partner directly with leading brands and creative agencies as their creative and strategic guide to generative AI. Architect and prototype AI-accelerated production workflows that help partners move faster and raise their storytelling. Create hands-on, high-craft content in Luma that sets the bar and becomes inspirational case studies. Consult with partner leadership, translating technical capability into concrete creative and business opportunities. Set the tone and the playbook for how the Forward Deployed Creative function engages partners in the region. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn Luma and the models deeply, meet priority partners, and understand their pipelines and where generative AI helps most. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build a real AI-accelerated workflow with a partner and produce a high-craft case study from it. jobs.title: Founding AE - DACH
jobs.description: Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid Type: Full-time Level: Senior Reporting to: Co-founder & CRO About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment. Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. Your Role We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. DACH is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, UK, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In DACH we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years. If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in DACH and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. You will report directly to the Co-founder, have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and a channel person alongside you to build the partner ecosystem. Your job is to generate pipeline, navigate deals, and close. No VP of Sales between you and the decision maker. No committee to approve your approach. Just a big market, a working product, and room to run. What You’ll Do Generate pipeline fast - primarily through your existing network. There is no inbound engine, no SDR handing you leads. You eat what you kill. Own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement Be the face of Nebuly in DACH - at events, in conversations, in the market Who You Are 6+ years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience in DACH Proven track record of closing multiple 7-figure enterprise contracts Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the DACH enterprise space Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads) You know how to win deals without inbound or SDRs - you drive your own pipeline Experience working alongside system integrators and advisory firms - you know how to bring them into a deal, co-sell with them, and build the relationship that eventually generates referrals. Comfortable with ambiguity, a lean process, and building as you go Fluent in German and English You do not need to have sold AI observability or conversational analytics before.

jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.  We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.  We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. About the role Hilo is looking for an experienced Human Factors Project Manager to own all of our human factors and usability work. Right now that work is split across Product, Design, Clinical Operations, QARA and outside agencies, and no single person is accountable for it. You'll be that person. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work. What you'll own Usability studies: You'll own the study calendar, protocols and relationships with external labs such as Sage Research. This covers formative and summative studies across hardware and software, including FDA submission work for Hilo Medical. You'll make sure findings get back to design on a regular schedule. IFU and Quick Start Guide: You'll decide what content goes in the QSG, the app and the IFU. You'll also own version control and localisation (Phrase, Novalins) and brief and manage freelance designers and print partners. Packaging: You'll own packaging briefs from start to finish and coordinate agencies (ARD, Superhuit, Carac Design) and freelance packaging designers. You'll keep the work aligned with regulatory, cost and manufacturing constraints. Clinical studies: You'll connect the human factors evidence from ClinOps-run trials with the human factors evidence for the product we ship to customers. Roadmap and reporting: You'll keep a single human factors roadmap and manage dependencies, resourcing and budgets across teams. Each month you'll report confidence levels and raise any risks to leadership. This is a part time contractor role of up to three days per week, with a total fee of CHF 17,500 for the initial engagement. We would like to start as soon as possible, with a review after three months. Requirements What you'll bring Human factors or usability engineering experience in medical devices, ideally with wearables or connected health Proven project or programme management: you've owned the plan, sequenced multiple workstreams and delivered on deadlines through others Hands-on knowledge of IEC 62366 usability engineering, use-related risk documentation (e.g. UFMEAs) and IFU development Experience managing agencies, labs and freelancers Clear, confident communication, with a track record of connecting Product, Clinical and Quality/Regulatory teams First priorities Audit of our current processes and human factors function Set up the usability study calendar Get a decision on the content split for the QSG "5-minute sheet" redesign Nice to have: FDA submission experience, a UX research background, and familiarity with InDesign/Figma localisation workflows Benefits At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:  Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. jobs.title: Account Executive - Cologne/ Düsseldorf
jobs.description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in NRW. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality You are comfortable working in both English and German If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission Flexible time off Team events What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Ability to follow runbooks, manage tickets carefully and document changes and troubleshooting clearly. Good communication, attention to detail, customer service and willingness to learn from senior engineers. Bonus skills: Exposure to Okta Workforce Identity Cloud or an Okta Certified Professional learning pathway. Introductory Terraform knowledge, including reading plans, understanding resources and using Git pull requests. Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications such as Microsoft 365, GitHub, Atlassian or Slack. Familiarity with SCIM provisioning or HR-driven joiner/mover/leaver workflows. Awareness of ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus or GDP

Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains. Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models. Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking. Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario. Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario. Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets. Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort). Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination. Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo. Must Haves: Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision. Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices. Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning. Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation. Nice to Haves: Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference). Exposure to satellite or geospatial data. Multi-agent or distributed systems experience. Genuine interest in space. What Can We Offer? You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. You'll build new expertise on an emerging class of models, reusable across other detection-like use cases, with a concrete prototype and benchmark the team can build on. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: Back Market is on a mission to make refurbished tech the new norm. To achieve this, we use data to better understand our customers, improve their experience, and make smarter product and business decisions. jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission

jobs.description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. L’IA représente une formidable opportunité de dépasser cette limite structurelle, qui freine l’innovation, l’efficience opérationnelle des hôpitaux et les diagnostics médicaux. L’équipe réunit des machine learning engineers autonomes et exigeants. Elle a déjà construit des fondations solides. Le prochain cap est clair : donner une direction commune aux sujets liés aux soins et à la recherche, faire des choix ambitieux et transformer des avancées techniques en produits utiles. jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction. You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning. You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications. You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data. You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas. Nice to Have Experience with frontier tabular ML methods. Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets. Location Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available. Compensation Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits). Benefits We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more. For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees. jobs.title: Abacus Consultant Finance, 80-100 %
jobs.description: Möglichkeit, von unseren Büros in Genf oder Bern aus zu arbeiten. Du begeisterst dich für Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, möchtest aber über die Zahlen hinausgehen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung von Unternehmen beitragen? Bei Fidigit stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt, denn wir bieten dank der Einführung von Abacus ERP und unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden einen aussergewöhnlichen Service. Als Teil der Fidinam-Gruppe, eines führenden Beratungsunternehmens in den Bereichen Steuern, Unternehmen, Immobilien und digitale Beratung in der Schweiz, sind wir mit mehr als 15 Standorten weltweit und über 300 Beratern hervorragend aufgestellt. Mit Standorten in Bern, Genf, Lugano, Luzern und Zürich sind wir der einzige Abacus-Vertriebspartner, der in allen drei Sprachregionen der Schweiz vertreten ist. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung zu beraten. Was du bei uns tun wirst: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei ihren Abacus-Finanzprojekten, von der Konzeption über die Einführung bis hin zur Schulung. Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich. Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus. Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting. Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet. Du berätst und begleitest unsere Kunden vor Ort oder remote. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei. Dein Profil: Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und hast eine hohe Affinität zu IT und Digitalisierung. Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit der Einführung oder Nutzung eines ERP-Systems in einem KMU-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Abacus ist ein grosser Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du schätzt den Kundenkontakt und verstehst es, ihre Bedürfnisse in konkrete Lösungen umzusetzen. Du beherrschst Französisch und Deutsch und bewegst dich sicher in einem professionellen englischen Umfeld. Was wir bieten: Die Möglichkeit, dich bei Fidigit durch Experten im Bereich Finanzen und Abacus-Software weiterzubilden. Zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten in diesem Tätigkeitsbereich in der Schweiz. Teilnahme an Schulungen beim Hersteller Abacus in Biel, um dich schnell fundierte Kenntnisse der Abacus-Software anzueignen. Abacus Platinum Partner innerhalb einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 60 Jahren Geschichte. Ein motivierendes, dynamisches und vor allem kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld. Ein Team von 8 Mitarbeitenden in Genf, 50 in der gesamten Schweiz. Zusammen mit den Teams von Fidinam sind wir rund 30 Personen an unserem Standort in Genf. Ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz (Lugano, Zürich, Luzern, Bern, Genf). Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Attraktive und marktgerechte Anstellungsbedingungen für alle Kompetenzstufen sowie interessante Zusatzleistungen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Paid Working Student: Medical Device Design and Engineering
jobs.description: About Piomic Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. Our team of biologists, engineers and designers combines high-quality medical research with a close focus on the people who use our devices. Our vision: life shouldn't be defined by a medical condition. What you'll do Develop and evaluate concepts for the packaging, fixation and accessories of a medical device Design geometry variants in CAD and produce them including additive manufacturing Build functional prototypes and demonstrators and test them for handling and fit Help develop a test setup that recognizes single-use components, from requirements to a working demonstration Document designs, tests and decisions so they can feed into regulated product development What you bring Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in industrial design, product design, mechanical/medical engineering or a related field Hands-on skills in CAD and prototyping, including 3D printing An independent, structured way of working and careful documentation English, German is a plus Nice to have Experience with plastics, silicone or injection-molded parts Basic electronics or embedded programming, for example microcontrollers or RFID/NFC Interest in regulated products such as medical devices You like to tinker and build things that work What we offer ownership from day one: your designs become working prototypes that go into testing Hands-on impact on a breakthrough therapy for one of the deadliest conditions in healthcare First-hand experience of how medical devices are developed under European and US regulatory requirements A paid position with competitive pay Hybrid work and a modern open workspace directly at the Zurich HB Flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams How to apply • Your CV • A short cover letter, one page at most, on which of the topics above interest you most • A few examples or references of your design or prototyping work, if you have them • Your university, program and how many hours per week you can work during the semester Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistent*in (Zürich)
jobs.description: Warum Ovivamed? Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern. Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit! Die Rolle Als Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistentin (a) steuerst du das tägliche operative Geschäft unserer Ovivamed-Praxisstandorte in der Schweiz (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Luzern). In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Du stellst einen reibungslosen Patient*innenfluss sowie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung unserer hohen klinischen und operativen Standards sicher. Als mitarbeitende Führungspersönlichkeit arbeitest du aktiv im Praxisalltag mit, unterstützt das Team von der Front aus und befähigt deine Kolleg*innen gleichzeitig zu fachlicher und persönlicher Bestleistung. Deine Aufgaben: Teamführung & Entwicklung : Du leitest, mentorst und schulst bestehende sowie neue Teammitglieder vor Ort und förderst deren berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Praxisorganisation : Du überwachst und optimierst die täglichen Abläufe in den Praxisstandorten, um eine nahtlose Patient*innenerfahrung und effiziente, gut strukturierte Abläufe zu gewährleisten. Qualitätsmanagement : Du implementierst, pflegst und setzt unsere Qualitätsmanagement-Strukturen an den Standorten konsequent durch. Einsatzplanung : Du koordinierst die Einsatzpläne des Teams, delegierst Aufgaben effektiv und stellst jederzeit eine optimale Abdeckung der Praxisaktivitäten sicher. Klinische Unterstützung : Du übernimmst allgemeine MPA-Tätigkeiten wie die Patientenadministration, Laborarbeiten, Triage sowie die Assistenz des ärztlichen Personals. Prozessoptimierung : Du identifizierst operative Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft und treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen aktiv voran. Dein Profil: Ausbildung : Eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Medizinische Praxisassistentin (MPA) mit eidgenössischem Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ). Berufserfahrung : Fundierte, praktische Erfahrung in einer Arztpraxis oder einem ähnlichen klinischen Umfeld. Führungskompetenz : Nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer leitenden oder stellvertretend leitenden Kapazität (z. B. als Leitende MPA oder Stellvertretung) sowie ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein diverses Team zu coachen, zu motivieren und zu befähigen. Organisationstalent : Exzellente Organisations- und Problemlösungskompetenzen, um in einem dynamischen Praxisumfeld stets den Überblick zu behalten. Digitale Affinität : Eine ausgeprägte Stärke und Begeisterung für die Nutzung moderner digitaler Gesundheitstools und Softwarelösungen. Kommunikation : Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen wie der ärztlichen Leitung und dem Praxismanagement. Was Ovivamed dir bietet : Die einzigartige Chance, die digitale Revolution im Gesundheitswesen in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling : je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau. jobs.title: AI Builder
jobs.description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. What you'll do A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context. In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work. The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece. What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. jobs.title: Staff Analyst - Risk and Fraud Systems
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. This is not a strategy-only role and it is not ownership of a large operational team. It is a hands-on build role at the intersection of risk, data, product, engineering and operations. What you'll do: Work hands-on with SQL (Snowflake, dbt), Python, statistics and modern AI-assisted tools to explore data, test hypotheses, prototype controls and evaluate results. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. Own the health of live controls: every rule and check has an owner, an expected volume, a measured yield and alerting when it goes quiet or drifts, and every change is tested and impact-assessed before release. Build and maintain a labelled library of confirmed fraud cases and a shared fraud typology: the basis for rules now and for machine-learning models with Data Science later. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. Backtest rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and design control experiments, shadow tests and phased roll-outs that measure both loss reduction and legitimate-customer impact. Produce decision artefacts that let senior leaders make trade-offs about risk appetite, engineering investment, customer experience and commercial growth. Stay with each major capability until it works in production, then establish its long-term owner and move to the next high-value problem. Expected 6 month outcomes: At least one major seller-risk journey has materially improved on agreed loss, approval, speed or manual-effort measures. Fraud/Risk Operations spends significantly less time on repetitive screening and more time on investigation, judgement and improvement. Stable capabilities have been handed to durable owners, leaving the role free to take on the next high-value problems. We'd love to hear from you if you: Significant experience building or improving merchant- or seller-side fraud detection at a PSP, acquirer, payfac, marketplace or Merchant of Record, and a working knowledge of how bust-out, transaction laundering and self-dealing show up in the data. Strong hands-on analytical ability, fluency in SQL (Snowflake, dbt or similar), Python and statistics, plus experience using LLMs on unstructured data such as website content or support tickets, with measured accuracy. jobs.description: Who We Are Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. As a Fraud Analytics Manager , you will own the analytics function supporting fraud, credit risk, and operations at Imprint. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with managerial scope, focused on building automation, tooling, and reporting infrastructure that reduces manual work and drives faster, smarter decisions across the team. You will act as the primary analytics owner for a set of problems that sit across fraud, credit, and risk: consolidating fragmented reporting, building shared backtesting frameworks, and deploying AI-assisted tooling to free up the team's time for higher-leverage work. jobs.description: We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning. jobs.title: Lead AI Architect - Data Platform
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. The Role We are hiring our first Lead AI Architect to design, build, and run the centralized data and AI platform that powers Banyan. The cornerstone of the work is a centralized data model, a Banyan data lake, that consolidates the data we already have and unlocks safe AI experimentation for our internal functional teams: Finance, M&A, Business Development, and others. This role is modeled on a classical Enterprise Architect role and adapted for an AI-first world. You will set the target-state architecture, choose the patterns we standardize on, write code yourself, and own the result. You will partner with our embedded business analysts and the leaders of each functional vertical so the platform stays grounded in real use cases, not abstractions. This is a player-coach role. You start hands-on. Over time you build and lead a small platform team. What You Will Build A centralized data lake on AWS: the single, governed source of truth for internal Banyan data. Designed for analytics, ML, and AI experimentation. A reference architecture for AI: patterns and building blocks our verticals use to go from idea to safe production: model selection, RAG, evaluation, observability, cost controls. Guardrails that make experimentation safe: data classification, access tiering, sandboxes, audit logging, and clear rules for what can be sent where. A platform team and operating model: the team, standards, and rituals that keep the platform reliable and improving as adoption grows. What You Will Do Define and own the target-state data and AI architecture for Banyan. Make the trade-offs explicit and write them down. Design and build the AWS-centric data lake. Set the patterns for storage, cataloging, query, ingestion, modeling, and lineage. Likely stack: S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, Iceberg or similar open table formats, plus Terraform or CDK for infrastructure as code. Stand up the AI experimentation layer: model access via Anthropic, OpenAI and other LLM Establish data contracts, schema standards, naming conventions, and a domain model that holds up as we add sources and acquire companies. Partner with our Senior Business Analysts embedded in Finance, M&A, and Business Development to translate use cases into platform requirements and to unblock their work. Define security, privacy, and AI safety guardrails. Classify data, design access tiering, and set the rules for handling PII, regulated data, and confidential portfolio information. Stay hands-on. Write code, ship infrastructure, run code reviews, and debug production issues. Architects who do not build lose touch. Build the team including vertical aligned Senior Business AI Analysts. Find suitable contractors for data platform engineers, ML platform engineers, and data engineers. Mentor them. Set the bar for engineering quality. Own platform reliability, observability, and cost. Set SLOs, monitor usage, and keep the bill rational as we scale. Represent Banyan's AI and data architecture to our executive team, our portfolio companies, and external partners. First-Year Outcomes A production-ready, governed data lake foundation deployed on AWS, with at least three priority data domains landed and modeled. At least two functional verticals onboarded to the platform with safe,

Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results. Your Role at impact.com: Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight. Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model. What You Bring: 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business. A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help. A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting. Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action. Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things. Nice to Have: Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality Experience with lead scoring Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 per year, plus an additional 5% vari

jobs.title: 3D & LiDAR Data Annotation Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments. As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume. Your Impact Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features. Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences. Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards. Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions. Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps. Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations. Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation. Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods. Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation. Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features. Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets. Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment. Nice to Haves Associate or bachelor’s degree. Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools. Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments. Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments. Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration. Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets. Compensation Additional Information Why You’ll Love Working Here At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models. You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You’ll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. jobs.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats. The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making. In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful. What You’ll Do Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality. Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy. Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes. Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions. Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure. Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions. What You Bring Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting). Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code. Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing). Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you. Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields. Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis. Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement Manage stakeholder relationships independently for assigned engagements; facilitate analytical meetings, communicate findings clearly, navigate competing interpretations, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.
